definition.script:
pipeline { agent any
environment { REPO_SSH = 'git@github.com:hms-dbmi/avillachlab-jenkins-bdc-etl.git' BRANCH = 'jenkins-backup-nightly-pipefail'
// S3 base prefix (no trailing slash required) S3_BASE = 's3://avillach-biodatacatalyst-deployments-3drb48r/pheno-server/jenkins_home' }
stages { stage('Backup Jenkins config to git + S3 (instance profile)') { steps { withCredentials([sshUserPrivateKey( credentialsId: 'bdc-etl-jenkins-push', keyFileVariable: 'SSH_KEY', usernameVariable: 'SSH_USER' )]) { sh '''#!/usr/bin/env bash set -euo pipefail
# --- sanity: instance profile auth for AWS --- command -v aws >/dev/null 2>&1 aws sts get-caller-identity --output json > /tmp/aws-caller.json
# --- GitHub SSH setup --- install -d -m 700 "$HOME/.ssh" KNOWN_HOSTS="$HOME/.ssh/known_hosts" grep -v '^github\\.com ' "$KNOWN_HOSTS" 2>/dev/null > "$KNOWN_HOSTS.tmp" || true ssh-keyscan -t ed25519 github.com >> "$KNOWN_HOSTS.tmp" 2>/dev/null mv "$KNOWN_HOSTS.tmp" "$KNOWN_HOSTS" chmod 600 "$KNOWN_HOSTS"
export GIT_SSH_COMMAND="ssh -i '$SSH_KEY' -o IdentitiesOnly=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -o UserKnownHostsFile='$KNOWN_HOSTS'"
WORKDIR="$(mktemp -d)" trap 'rm -rf "$WORKDIR"' EXIT cd "$WORKDIR"
# --- clone/update branch --- git clone --no-tags "$REPO_SSH" repo cd repo
git config user.name "jenkins" git config user.email "jenkins@hms-dbmi.local"
git fetch origin "$BRANCH" || true if git show-ref --verify --quiet "refs/remotes/origin/$BRANCH"; then git checkout -B "$BRANCH" "origin/$BRANCH" else git checkout -B "$BRANCH" fi git pull --ff-only origin "$BRANCH" 2>/dev/null || true
# --- S3 model: overwrite is fine (bucket versioning keeps history) --- DEST_LATEST="${S3_BASE}/latest/"
# Strict allowlist sync direct from JENKINS_HOME (NO SECRETS, NO WORKSPACE, NO BUILDS) aws s3 sync "${JENKINS_HOME}/" "$DEST_LATEST" \ --delete \ --only-show-errors \ --exclude "*" \ --include "config.xml" \ --include "plugins.txt" \ --include "scriptApproval.xml" \ --include "jenkins.model.JenkinsLocationConfiguration.xml" \ --include "nodes/**" \ --include "jobs/**/config.xml"
# Write a small manifest to help pick restore points (versions of this file are your index) cat > /tmp/jenkins-home-backup-manifest.json <<EOF { "ts_utc": "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)", "s3_latest_prefix": "${DEST_LATEST}", "jenkins_home": "${JENKINS_HOME}", "caller_identity": $(cat /tmp/aws-caller.json) } EOF aws s3 cp /tmp/jenkins-home-backup-manifest.json "${DEST_LATEST}_manifest.json" --only-show-errors
# --- Git backup (rolling latest view; NO SECRETS) --- cd jenkins-docker rm -rf jobs jobs_old var nodes mkdir -p jobs
# jobs configs into repo (config.xml only) ( cd "${JENKINS_HOME}/jobs" find . -type f -name "config.xml" -print0 \ | tar --null -T - -cf - \ | (cd "$WORKDIR/repo/jenkins-docker/jobs" && tar -xf -) )
# controller-level files (non-secret) for f in config.xml plugins.txt scriptApproval.xml jenkins.model.JenkinsLocationConfiguration.xml; do [ -f "${JENKINS_HOME}/${f}" ] && cp -f "${JENKINS_HOME}/${f}" . || true done
# nodes (agent defs) [ -d "${JENKINS_HOME}/nodes" ] && cp -a "${JENKINS_HOME}/nodes" . || true
# Hard guard: never commit secrets/credentials (and don't even let them linger) rm -rf secrets secret.key credentials.xml identity.key.enc 2>/dev/null || true
cd .. git add -A
if git diff --cached --quiet; then echo "No changes detected; nothing to push" exit 0 fi
git commit -m "Jenkins backup: $(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" git push -u origin "$BRANCH" ''' } } } } }
